messages.subject: Problem with M2 statistic
parts:
Hi Phil
 
I'm trying to estimate  a confirmatory model through the mirt.model() function. my measurement instrument is fully composed of 42 binary items my aim is to assess the goodness of fit of this model,
I type the following syntax
datataw<- read.csv(fille.choose(), header= T, sep= ";")
mode(datataw)
list
 
model2<- mirt.model ('F1= 1-23
F2= 24-41
COV= F1*F2')
then
 mod5<- (mirt(datataw,model2,itemtype= "2PL", method= "MHRM))
then
M2(mod5)
but i receive the following error message
fit statistics can not be computed when there are missing data. pass suitable theta and impute arguments to compute statitics following multiple data imputations.
What i can't understand is that my original data dosen't contain any missing data!?
please I'm a very beginner with R and i'm really lost.
Is there something wrong with my syntax?
how can i fix the problem to obtain the M2 statistics
Thank you for your help!!
mod5<- (mirt(datataw, model2, itemtype= "2PL", method= "MHRM"))

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Problem with M2 statistic
parts:
Are you 100% certain that there is no missing data? Does any(is.na(datataw)) return TRUE? There's no other reason that this function would stop with that message.

Phil
